display_name.description: Public display name shown to other members.

city.description: City auto-populated from the member's FCC license address when their callsign is verified.

state.description: State auto-populated from the member's FCC license address when their callsign is verified.

avatar_focal_x.description: Horizontal focal point for the avatar (0-100).

avatar_focal_y.description: Vertical focal point for the avatar (0-100).

avatar_zoom.description: Zoom level for the avatar (1 = fit, higher = cropped in).

banner_url.description: Optional cover photo shown as the profile header banner.

banner_focal_x.description: Horizontal focal point for the banner cover photo (0-100).

banner_focal_y.description: Vertical focal point for the banner cover photo (0-100).

banner_zoom.description: Zoom level for the banner cover photo (1 = fit, higher = cropped in).

social_discord.description: Discord handle or username (e.g. username or username#1234).
